hub_help: Enter your hub's web address. You'll sign in on the next screen.
hub_hint: If your hub is under a path, include it, for example https://hub.example.com/persona
launch_at_login: Open Persona when you sign in to this computer
launch_requires_approval: macOS needs your approval in System Settings before Persona can open at sign-in.
link_intro: Persona Link is a separate, optional background service. You do not need it to chat or use Agents on another computer.
link_absent: Persona Link is not installed. Install it separately only if this computer should run Agents.
link_install_guide: Persona Link is a separate install for running Agents on this computer. Open your hub's Machines › Add Computer page and follow its Persona Link steps, then return here to pair. This desktop app does not install a background service without your choice.
hub_invalid: Check the hub address and try again.
link_footer: Link and the resident node keep running without this app. Only install them on a computer you want the hub to reach.
update_failed: Couldn't check for updates. Persona will try again later.
